title: Blackberry B-Burst(B-Pop) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blackberry B-Burst(B-Pop) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Flavor
Experience the delightful burst of juicy blackberries with every puff of the Blackberry B-Burst(B-Pop) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Its rich, smooth flavor offers a sweet and tart profile that captures the true essence of fresh, ripe blackberries. This flavor delivers an irresistible blend that will keep your taste buds satisfied all day.
Disposable
Designed for convenience, the Blackberry B-Burst(B-Pop) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is perfect for those on the go. With no need for refilling, it’s a hassle-free option for quick enjoyment. Once you’ve savored every last puff, simply dispose of it responsibly. Lightweight and compact, it’s easy to carry, ensuring you always have your favorite flavor handy.
Key Features
Puff Count:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow: Adjustable for customized draw
